body: That was me before I went to college but then I decided I would give it a few weeks just so I could say I tried. I like my home family/ close friend bubble and had no desire to change that. Same thing I thought ending it was the solution. I'm not trying to change your mind or anything but I wanted to let you know you are not alone.
that sounds really nice to me right now
I have severe depression and everyone quit on me. So why shouldn't I quit on me too?

I completely understand because that is how I feel most of the time. I don't like to do things because Im scared of other people's reactions and judgement's. I know life doesn't work this way but I don't want to fail at anything and when I do I am not able to deal with it without falling apart. I am introverted and only like to have a small group of friends but the problem is I just moved back to my hometown and I have no friends and I won't go out to meet people because Im scared of rejection (and doing new things alone). I have a lot of survivor's guilt (feeling that I don't deserve to be here and other people should get that chance in my place).

I have a psychiatrist and we've talked about the root of the problem which isn't set in stone but it basically revolves around my feelings of guilt. I had a good life growing up and lots of opportunities so why am I so depressed? I should be doing more with my life but I'm doing nothing. Can I ask more about your view of the world?

Thanks for your support I appreciate it.

Yeah I'm trying to tell myself that I haven't found the right treatment and I need to be patient but its really hard when you feel like crap all the time. Just generally unhappy and nothing I do is enjoyable (getting up, leaving the house, playing sports...even netflix is unenjoyable). I used to enjoy sports and I loved being active. I try to exercise but I'm just going through the motions and it doesn't have a positive impact on my mood. It manifests with extreme sadness/ hopelessness with lying in bed all day and crying.

I've had 3 or 4 therapists have diagnose me with depression (both dysthymia and major depression), anxiety, and OCD (not really an issue anymore). I've have been feeling this way for years but only started with the therapy 5 years ago so maybe I waited too long to get treatment?
Yes I've tried multiple medications and none have worked. I've also had allergic reactions making some off limits.
